context: Places vegetation instances such as trees and shrubs based on biome and terrain properties.
description: Uses density maps and Poisson disk sampling to determine positions of vegetation instances and spawns them via the PCG framework.

classes.name: VegetationSystem
classes.description: Responsible for vegetation placement on a tile.

methods.name: ComputeDensityMap(biomeMap, slopeMap)
methods.description: Determine vegetation density per cell based on biome type and slope.
methods.pseudocode: For each cell: base density from biome lookup; reduce density if slope > threshold or altitude too high; store density.

methods.name: SamplePositions(densityMap, minDistance)
methods.description: Generate sample points using Poisson disk sampling within the tile bounds.
methods.pseudocode: Initialize empty list; while not enough points: pick random candidate; reject if too close to existing points; accept with probability proportional to density.

methods.name: SpawnInstances(tile, positions)
methods.description: Spawn instanced static meshes via Unreal's PCG framework for each sampled position.
methods.pseudocode: For each position: choose tree type based on biome; call PCG to spawn instance at position with random rotation and scale.

pseudocode: Compute density, sample positions with Poisson disk, then spawn vegetation instances.
